notes.title: Engine & Rendering Update
notes.content:
Hello Hunters!

[previewyoutube="M97nOHTxUJc;full"][/previewyoutube]


We have a new update for you! In this one we have updated the game engine and rendering pipeline to a new one. This change allowed us to improve graphics, better optimize the game, upgrade backed tools & more. A good example of this are our new awesome track highlights. We also improved the tutorial and cut a lot of its playtime.



In case the new update brings issues, the previous version is accessible from Steam’s beta system as “1.0 - Full Release Version”.

notes.title: Difficulty Levels Update
notes.content:
Greetings Hunters!

[previewyoutube=FS_6Teo9rvE;full][/previewyoutube]
In this update we are happy to add difficulty levels to the game! There are now three to choose from: casual, hunter and realistic. Animals in casual mode have weaker senses and it is perfect when you just want to go on a relaxing hunt. It also helps you locate animals by highlighting an animal when you activate their call.

When you want to really push your hunting skills, realistic mode provides a real challenge! Animals have strong senses so getting close leaves very little room for mistakes. Track and carcass highlights are also turned off by default so good shot placement is key since tracking will be more difficult. They can be turned back on from the settings. This mode provides higher rewards. Hunter is the default difficulty that the game has offered so far.

You can change the difficulty when starting the game but it can’t be changed during gameplay. Trophy statues in the trophy room will also display the difficulty level.

We also adjusted vegetation settings so please test and adjust them. More about this change is in the patch notes below.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41156574/19bc75c6630695fd12d56022919c8985d4561329.png

 Added three difficulty settings: casual, hunter and realistic
 Casual has lower animal senses, activating an animal call will highlight the animal, and rewards are smaller
 Hunter is the default difficulty that the game has been so far. Animal hearing and sight are slightly increased in closer distance.
 Realistic mode is a real challenge for master hunters! It has strong animal senses, track and carcase highlights are turned off by default but it provides higher rewards.
 You can change the difficulty at the main menu but it can’t be changed during gameplay


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41156574/10ff58625f7374dabb259d2e8c27e0a21e438d2b.png

 Improved far away terrains and their textures
 Vegetation graphic settings reworked and adjusted*
 Increased vegetation distance in higher settings**
 Added reverb zones to forests and mountains to create slight echo for weapons and callers


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41156574/d7b90ddf19e9f00100fe84ddb95619bb2a579ad2.png

 Reworked animal tracks (new highlights, new texture to make it easier to track without highlights)
 Improved animal pathfinding on steep slopes 
 Improved animal need time behavior and travel distances


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41156574/17ca57bb0c6d8498aceaa85dec55610275a97e8a.png

 Added difficulty level info on trophy statues

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41156574/0f46252be71637b7407b310f2652a83c554683f7.png

 Improved loading time when traveling into the reserve
 Adjusted droppings’ LODs


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41156574/1089d8e06d4e3a6c8825abefc9a27f3a5b402bdc.png

 Fixed an issue where water would render on top of the fog
 Fixed an issue where animals could only see 90 degrees in front of them
 Fixed another issue that caused floating tracks on a specific locations of the map
 Fixed an issue where outpost buttons on quick hunt map didn’t work and the player always ended up on the same outpost
 Fixed an issue where arrow would keep snapping and unsnapping when realistic bow setting was on
 Fixed an issue where impact audios were heard beyond the maximum audio distance
 Fixed an issue where some SFX audios weren’t tied on SFX audio slider
 Fixed structure colliders on shooting range
 Fixed an issue where proper sound didn’t play when walking on shooting range
 Fixed an issue where one shooting range control box changed the distance of another lanes target

* Grass and plant densities were grouped under one button and low density was increased to the previous medium setting. There weren’t much difference in performance between these two and the game looked much worse in low setting before.
** Low and medium distances remain relatively the same but high and ultra settings render vegetation further than before. Ultra setting is much further so we advise you to test these settings yourself.

Enjoy the experience that the new difficulty levels bring! Let us know what you think in the forums and discord. Happy hunting!

notes.title: Virtual Hunter's Anniversary And Development Update
notes.content:
Greetings Hunters!

Exactly one year ago today, we released Virtual Hunter for early access. It was exciting to finally put out our game that we had been working on for so long. We also knew that this was just the beginning and our real work was just starting. Through the year we have added several new species, tons of features, fixed issues reported by players and improved the graphics and performance. Our biggest update has been animal taxidermy and trophy mounts, which was well received and gave players freedom to show off their most treasured trophies in the lodge. It’s been an amazing journey so far and we want to take this time to thank everyone who has played. We have read every comment, appreciated all feedback and enjoyed the discussions in our Discord community. Our goal is to create the best VR hunting experience and chose early access so we can do so with the players. The game would not be what it is today without all of you. Cheers to all of you virtual hunters!

We'd like to also give you an update on what is going on with Virtual Hunter’s development since our last update. We started a big process of moving the game from SteamVR to OpenXR and updating our engine and tools to newer versions. This way we future proof the game for other platforms, improve useability and performance for headsets on Steam that doesn’t use SteamVR and simplify the process on our end to work on different versions of the game. This is a massive task and requires us to completely rewrite big parts of the game regarding interactions and rendering. Good news is that we are making good progress but it will take us sometime to get it fully done and ready for you guys. This is necessary for us to do because it gives us more flexibility, more tools and features to work on the upcoming content faster! 

Even though we are mainly working on this big change, we have a content update planned in between. You can expect teasers of it when we are getting closer to it as always! I’m sure you'll like it :)
